## Page 14

In 2024 and 2025, the Company's total revenue was 1,003.57 and 
844.43 MB respectively, comprising sales revenue of 925.91 and 
832.79 MB respectively. 
The Company's sales revenue decreased by (93.12) MB or 
(10.06%), mainly due to a decrease in sales of medical -grade 
plastic compound and a slowdown in orders for plastic 
compound for the construction industry.Revenue
The Company's gross profit margin increased due to improved 
production efficiency, better raw material allocation and 
production costs, and a reduction in SG&A.
Gross profit for the plastic compound business was 117.30 MB 
or 14.09%, increased from 2024 which had a gross profit of 
58.63 MB or 6.33%.The company has a net profit in 2025 of 27.69 MB, divided 
into a net profit of 6.58 MB from the plastic compound 
business and subsidiaries, and a share of profit from the 
investment in the associate company (ADBS) of 21.11 MB.Net Profit
The company has undertaken organizational 
restructuring during 2025 and there was no extraordinary 
item in 2025. The company's administrative expenses 
were 77.37 MB decrease 20.67 MB or 21.08% from 98.04 MB 
in 2024, which included expenses related to the sale of 
additional shares in ADB Sealant Co., Ltd. and the transfer 
of assets related to that business.Note
